principle: Two separate products: IRRIGATION theme → FlahaCALC (irrigation & weather); NUTRITION theme → FlahaFAST (nutrient management). Never merge into one product identity.
handoffRule: Each pack targets one primary product. Human handoff only. Never auto-update FlahaCALC, FlahaFAST, or FlahaSOIL engines.

packs.title: FlahaCALC irrigation backbone — Kc × ETo (sample)
packs.summary: Equation and catalogue-aligned notes for ETc and net/gross irrigation. Values are illustrative literature / FAO-56 table identity — not live Calc DB writes.

items.title: ETc = Kc × ETo
items.bodyText: Crop water demand backbone used by FlahaCalc irrigation requirement path.

items.title: Net irrigation after effective rainfall
items.bodyText: Net depth = max(0, ETc − Pe). Quick estimate may use Pe ≈ 0.8×P; project water balance uses storage-limited Pe.

items.title: Gross irrigation and application efficiency
items.bodyText: Gross = Net / Ea. Catalogue system efficiencies (e.g. drip 0.90) are defaults, not verified field performance.

items.title: Tomato mid-season Kc (FAO-56 table identity)
items.bodyText: Illustrative identity match to FlahaCalc cropDatabase Tomato kc_mid = 1.15 (FAO-56 Table 12). Literature reviews may differ by climate and management.

structured.context: FAO-56 Table 12 identity for Calc crop table comparison

items.title: Drip catalogue efficiency (Calc systems table)
items.bodyText: FlahaCalc catalogue lists Drip Irrigation efficiency 0.90. Field uniformity checks still required (see water-saving METHOD notes).

structured.context: catalogue Drip Irrigation — not verified field Ea

items.title: Runtime requires verified application rate
items.bodyText: FlahaCalc only treats runtime as operational when verifiedApplicationRateMmPerH is set; catalogue rates are illustrative only.

items.title: Do not merge Calc FAO soil table with FlahaSOIL PAW silently
items.bodyText: Calc water balance defaults use FAO-56 Table 19 θFC/θWP by USDA texture; FlahaSOIL may estimate retention via Saxton–Rawls. Comparison notes only (4S-D).

items.title: Reference — FAO Irrigation & Drainage Paper 56
items.bodyText: Kc, stage lengths, depletion fraction p, and soil water characteristics tables underpin FlahaCalc crop and soil parameter files.

packs.title: FlahaFAST water quality and nutrient target context (sample)
packs.summary: Hydroponic EC/pH and element-target identities for FlahaFast. Illustrative literature-style notes — never auto-write salt matrices or formulations.

items.title: Fruiting vegetables solution EC band (product-style)
items.bodyText: FlahaFast CropRecommendationService lists Fruiting vegetables EC min/optimal/max ≈ 1.5 / 2.0 / 3.0. Treat as product-default context, not a global law.

structured.context: Fast CROP_EC_RANGES max — human review before any product change

items.title: Leafy greens solution pH band (product-style)
items.bodyText: Fast default Leafy greens pH range ≈ 5.8–6.5 (optimal 6.0).

items.title: Tomato vegetative K target identity (illustrative)
items.bodyText: Example nutrient identity: fruiting crop vegetative K often high priority in Fast preferences. Numeric targets must be paired with growth stage and unit ppm.

structured.context: illustrative — verify against Fast profile before product work

items.title: Source water ions subtract from fertilizer targets
items.bodyText: FlahaFast water profiles carry element concentrations (ppm or mmol/L) plus EC/pH. Formulation math must account for water contribution — do not ignore source water when comparing literature recipes.

items.title: HydroBuddy matrix / DOF note
items.bodyText: Stoichiometry uses element–salt matrix solve (HydroBuddy lineage). Default DOF element is often S — pack stores identity only.

structured.form: solve salt masses for target element vector (DOF element excluded)

items.title: Irrigation water EC vs soil ECe
items.bodyText: solutionEc / irrigationWaterEcDsM is not soil ECe (FlahaSOIL). Never auto-map without method and medium context.

crossProductCaution: FlahaSOIL soil ECe is a different medium — compare only with method context

items.title: Reference — HydroBuddy technical lineage
items.bodyText: FlahaFast calculation engine documents HydroBuddy Pascal algorithm compatibility for matrix construction and unit conversion (kg per m³ → g).
